issues.description: Stock.take(String) has inconsistent return types across artifacts: the problem statement/UML specifies `Stock.take(String): int` (e.g., to indicate failure via -1), but the template repository defines `take(String)` as returning `boolean`. This mismatch blocks implementing SealSaloon.checkOrderReady() as implied/used in the reference solution (checking for -1) and will cause compilation/logic conflicts for students following the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template signature of `Stock.take(String)` to return `int` (e.g., new remaining quantity on success, `-1` on failure) to match the UML/specification and the provided solution; update the template method body accordingly.
